It never means the page is good; see the craft manifest for the half that asks whether the work was actually done. === NEGATIVE CONTROL (a deliberately slop page; these results are only worth reading because this one trips) === control: http://127.0.0.1:8796/.impeccable-control.html engine: browser (URL, computed styles resolved) http://127.0.0.1:8796/.impeccable-control.html [gradient-text] background-clip: text + gradient → Gradient text is decorative rather than meaningful — a common AI tell, especially on headings and metrics. Use solid colors for text. [ai-color-palette] Purple/violet gradient background → Purple/violet gradients and cyan-on-dark are the most recognizable tells of AI-generated UIs. Choose a distinctive, intentional palette. [body-text-viewport-edge]

with 72-char body bleeds to viewport edge (left 8px / right 8px) → Body paragraphs render flush against the left or right viewport edge with no container providing horizontal padding. Wrap content in a container with at least 16px (ideally 24-32px) of horizontal padding, or apply max-width with mx-auto. [ai-color-palette] Purple/violet accent colors detected → Purple/violet gradients and cyan-on-dark are the most recognizable tells of AI-generated UIs. Choose a distinctive, intentional palette. [gradient-text] background-clip: text + gradient → Gradient text is decorative rather than meaningful — a common AI tell, especially on headings and metrics. Use solid colors for text. [low-contrast] pixel contrast 1.6:1 median 3.3:1 (need 3:1) on background-clip text, gradient background "Unlock the power of AI for your business" → Text does not meet WCAG AA contrast requirements (4.5:1 for body, 3:1 for large text). Increase the contrast between text and background. 6 anti-patterns found. control fired: YES === THE PAGES === --- Home-laptop.html engine: browser (URL, computed styles resolved) (no output) === WHAT THIS RUN COULD NOT SEE === Nothing known: the browser engine ran, so computed styles were resolved.
